snippet.title: Delicious Emily´s Road Trip | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Do you remember the whole family piling into the car for a summer vacation road trip? Feeling like the days would never end, travelling from state to state, seeing the country as it was meant to be seen? And if you never took a road trip, now is your chance! Join the O’Malleys as they travel Route 66, meeting old friends and new, discovering America along the way.

Download it today in your app store https://go.onelink.me/qF1z

Stay up-to-date with all things game related with the GameHouse Original Stories News!
